facts.text: Founded in 1994 as Beverly Hills Internet by David Bohnett and John Rezner.
Organized user homepages into themed virtual neighborhoods with street-style addresses.
Hosted millions of user-built pages; by the late 2000s the count was reported in the tens of millions.
Acquired by Yahoo! in 1999 in a stock deal reported at the time at roughly 3.6 billion US dollars.
Yahoo! announced the shutdown in April 2009 and closed the US service on October 26, 2009.
Before closure, volunteer archivists including Archive Team raced to mirror millions of pages; a substantial portion survives in the Internet Archive.
